title: Letter Dated January 9, 1934, From The HBM Consulategeneral Re Yih Dah Tsung

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
File No. C. & S. B. REGISTRY.
5655.
S.2, Special Branch
REPORT
Date February 21 - 21 / 34

Subject (in full) Letter dated January 9, 1934, from the H.B.M. Consulate-General re: Yih Dah Tsung(葉大春).

Made by D.I. Kuh Pao-hwa Forwarded by D.I. Townsend

In compliance with the instructions of the Officer i/c Special Branch contained in the attached memo dated January 30, 1934, regarding the associates of a communist suspect named Yih Dah Tsung(葉大春), I have to report the following result of enquiries made by the staff of this Section :-

TAN TIAN SENG(陳天生), age 22, native of Fokien, is stated to have been educated in Sumatra, Dutch East Indies. In the summer of 1931 he came to Shanghai and studied for two years in the Middle School Department of the Chinan University, Chenju. He later joined the Chao Kuang(僑光) Middle School, 1607/09 Sinza Road, and is now studying in the 2nd year grade of that school. He is occupying Room 13 of the school dormitory together with Yih Dah Tsung(葉大春) and Tan Djin Chuan(陳仁全) and is on friendly terms with a few other school-mates. His associates include some students of the Chinan University and he is known to frequent the Isis Theatre, 523 Jukong Road, and the Chan Mei Ki(增茂記) Restaurant, 442 East Wuchang Road.

TAN DJIN CHUAN(陳仁全), age 20, native of Fokien, is said to be an ex-student of the Tiong Hwa(中華) School, Selangor, F.M.S. About one and a half years ago he arrived in Shanghai and enrolled in the Chao Kuang Middle School where he is now studying in the 1st year grade. He is sharing a room with Yih Dah Tsung and Tan Tian Seng. He is a close friend of Yih Dah Tsung and Tan Tian Seng and is on friendly terms with a few students in the Chinan University. He usually passes his spare time in visiting certain bookstores on Foochow Road and Cantonese foodshops along North Szechuen Road.

（左侧批注：）
D.I. Townsend

日期 1934年2月21日

主题（全称） 英国驻上海总领事馆1934年1月9日来函，关于：葉大春 (Yih Dah Tsung)。

由 警探 顾宝华 (Kuh Pao-hwa) 制作 经 警探 Townsend 转呈

遵照附后1934年1月30日备忘录中特别科主管警官的指示，就一名名为葉大春 (Yih Dah Tsung) 的共产党嫌疑人的同伙进行调查，现将本科人员调查结果报告如下：-

陳天生 (TAN TIAN SENG)，22岁，福建人，据称曾在荷属东印度苏门答腊受教育。1931年夏他来到上海，在真如暨南大学中学部学习了两年。后来他加入位于新闸路1607/09号的僑光中学，目前在该校二年级就读。他与葉大春 (Yih Dah Tsung) 和陳仁全 (Tan Djin Chuan) 同住学校宿舍13号房间，并与另外几名同学关系友好。他的交往圈子包括一些暨南大学的学生，据悉他常去九江路523号的伊西斯大戏院 (Isis Theatre) 和武昌东路442号的增茂記 (Chan Mei Ki) 餐馆。

陳仁全 (TAN DJIN CHUAN)，20岁，福建人，据称是马来联邦雪兰莪州中華学校 (Tiong Hwa School) 的往届学生。约一年半前他抵达上海，进入僑光中学注册，目前在该校一年级就读。他与葉大春和陳天生合住一个房间。他是葉大春和陳天生的密友，并与暨南大学的几名学生关系友好。他通常在福州路的某些书店以及北四川路沿线的广东菜馆度过闲暇时间。

（左侧批注：）
警探 Townsend

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT
S.2, Special Branch.
Date January 29, 1934

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE C. Bils. No. REGISTRY. No. D 5655 Branch Date 29 / 1 / 34）

Subject (in full) Letter dated January 9, 1934, from the H.B.M. Consulate-General re: Yih Dah Tsung (葉大喜).
Made by D.I. Kuh Pao-hwa Forwarded by D-2. [签名]

With reference to the attached enquiry from the H.B.M. Consulate-General dated January 9, 1934, relating to a student named Yih Dah Tsung (葉大喜) who is said to be living in the Overseas Chinese School, 28 Avenue Road, I have to report the following :-

The Overseas Chinese Middle School, which is commonly known as the Chao Kuang Middle School (僑光中學), is located at 1607/09 Sinza Road. No.28 Avenue Road, the address as mentioned in the Consular letter, does not exist.

Yih Dah Tsung, who came to Shanghai from Singapore in July 1933, is described as being 20 years of age and a native of Amoy, Fokien Province. When registering at the school, however, he stated his native place to be Anchi (安溪), Fokien, and gave his father's address as follows :-
Mr. Yap Twee (葉玉堆)
No.42 Club Street,
Singapore.

Yih is now in the Second Year-Grade of the aforesaid school and is living in Room 13 of the Second Dormitory at 1607/09 Sinza Road. On account of general slackness in his studies, he was not permitted to participate in the semi-annual examination of his class at the end of 1933.

Discreet enquiries show that he is on friendly terms with two fellow countrymen and class-mates named Tan Tian Seng (陳天生) and Tan Djin Chuan (陳仁全) who also share his room. He is known to be in close touch with Tee Lip Ka (鄭立加), a student in the Middle School Department of the Chinan University at Chenju.

Nothing further is known by this office regarding the

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 C. Bils. No. 登记处。号 D 5655 科 日期 1934年1月29日）

主题（全称） 英国驻上海总领事馆1934年1月9日来函，关于：葉大喜 (Yih Dah Tsung)。
由 警探 顾宝华 (Kuh Pao-hwa) 制作 经 D-2 [签名] 转呈

关于附后的英国驻上海总领事馆1934年1月9日的查询，涉及一名据说住在爱文义路28号华侨学校的学生葉大喜 (Yih Dah Tsung)，现报告如下：-

华侨中学，通称僑光中學 (Chao Kuang Middle School)，位于新闸路1607/09号。领事信函中提到的地址爱文义路28号并不存在。

葉大喜于1933年7月从新加坡来到上海，据描述年龄为20岁，籍贯为福建省厦门。然而，在学校注册时，他声称其籍贯为福建安溪 (Anchi)，并提供了其父亲的地址如下：-
葉玉堆 (Mr. Yap Twee) 先生
新加坡俱乐部街42号。

葉目前在该校二年级就读，居住在新闸路1607/09号第二宿舍的13号房间。由于平时学习懈怠，他未被允许参加1933年底班级的半期考试。

经谨慎调查显示，他与两名同乡兼同班同学陳天生 (Tan Tian Seng) 和陳仁全 (Tan Djin Chuan) 关系友好，这两人也与他同住一室。据悉他与郑立加 (Tee Lip Ka) 保持密切联系，后者是真如暨南大学中学部的学生。

本处对报告中提及的人员

page_data.en:
S 5655
Shanghai,
9th January 1934.

My dear Givens,
The Special Branch, Singapore is
rather interested in the following person Yip Dah Yong 葉大春
He is a young Hokkien ex student of the Singapore
Chinese High School, which has given so much trouble
to the Singapore authorities in recent years as it
is a hot bed of communism in the Straits Settlements.
This man was studying at the Chao Kuang Middle School
No.103 Seymour Road, Shanghai, and was associated
with (梁自强 Liang Zi Qiang) who was arrested by the Public
Safety Bureau at Shanghai on November 10th 1932 as a
suspected communist. 葉大春 Yip Dah Yong is now residing
at the Overseas Chinese School, 28 Avenue Road.
If it is possible to find out anything
about him and his associates I should be most grateful
for the information.

Yours sincerely,
[Signature]

T.P.Givens,Esq.,
Special Branch,
S.M.P.

（左侧批注：x dec S. 565H.）
page_data.zh:
S 5655
上海，
1934年1月9日。

亲爱的 Givens，
新加坡特别科对以下人物颇感兴趣：葉大春 (Yip Dah Yong)
他是一名年轻的福建籍前新加坡南洋华侨中学学生，该校近年来给新加坡当局带来诸多麻烦，因为它是海峡殖民地的共产主义温床。
此人在上海西摩路103号的僑光中学读书，并与梁自强 (Liang Zi Qiang) 有交往，梁于1932年11月10日作为共产党嫌疑人被上海公安局逮捕。葉大春 (Yip Dah Yong) 目前居住在爱文义路28号的华侨学校。
如果能查明有关他及其同伙的任何情况，我将不胜感激。

您真诚的，
[签名]

T.P. Givens 先生，
特别科，
上海公共租界工部局警务处。

（左侧批注：x dec S. 565H。）
